Central China Daily News, Circulation Daily News, Chinese-

INSPECTION OF SCHOOLS BY S.M.C.

Owing to the increased population, schools in
Shanghai have made handsome profits. Although large
numbers of schools have been established, there is still
overcrowding in various schools.
As this state of affairs will seriously affect
both public health and education, the Education Department
of the S.M.C. has been detailing officials to make
inspections of primary schools established by the Council
as well as those private Chinese schools which receive
grants-in-aid from the Council.
It is learned that the inspectors found the
sanitary installations in the dormitories of 21 schools
requiring improvement.
The Education Department of the Council
yesterday issued warnings to these schools to make
improvements immediately, while two of them were ordered
to make a complete overhaul within one week.

（批：Here is an inspection being
carried out. Is there any
reaction from the schools visited
since they are mostly Primary schools.
J. J. Loh.）

工部局检查学校

由于人口增加，上海的学校获利丰厚。虽然建立了大量学校，但各校仍然存在拥挤现象。
鉴于此种状况将严重影响公共卫生和教育，工部局教育局已派遣官员对工部局创办的小学以及接受工部局津贴的中国私立学校进行检查。
据悉，检查人员发现21所学校的宿舍卫生设施需要改进。
工部局教育局昨日向这些学校发出警告，要求立即改进，其中两所学校被责令在一周内进行全面整修。

October 25, 1939.
Afternoon Translation

Central China Daily News, Hwa Pao:-
FRENCH MUNICIPAL COUNCIL TO SUPPRESS PRIVATE SCHOOLS
IN CONCESSION

Contending that the bad administration
and inadequate sanitary installations of many private
schools in the French Concession may seriously affect
the promotion of modern education, the Education
Department of the French Municipal Council recently
instructed its subordinates to take action against
these private schools concerned. Later, those latter
submitted to the Council a joint petition for registration,
thereby enabling them to carry on operations.
It is learned that the Educational
Department of the Council has not granted the request
and that all schools of a private nature will be suppressed.

Sin Tsing Nien Morning News (新青年日報) :- 12-10-38 (171)

FRENCH AUTHORITIES AND CHINESE UNIVERSITIES

Following the outbreak of the August 13
hostilities, the Chinan University (暨南), the Futan
University (復旦), the Utopia University (大同) and
the Great China University (大夏) removed into the
French Concession, but as they had failed to register
with the French authorities, these universities were
ordered to remove from the Concession.
It is learned that the Great China University
has secured a house in the vicinity of Bubbling Well
Road and Gordon Road.
The Chinan University has resumed classes
in a house on Chengtu Road.
The Futan University has rented rooms in
the Chung Ih Building (中一大樓) on Peking Road and will
re-open soon.
The Utopia University has not yet found
suitable premises.
At present only the Chiao Tung University
remains in the French Concession.
Information received reveals that there
are in Shanghai about 700 universities, middle schools
and primary schools, with roll call of about 130,000
students.

法国当局与中国大学

继“八·一三”战事爆发后，暨南大学、复旦大学、大同大学和大夏大学迁入法租界，但因未向法国当局注册，这些大学被勒令迁出租界。
据悉，大夏大学已在静安寺路与戈登路附近觅得一处房屋。
暨南大学已在成都路的一处房屋内复课。
复旦大学已租用北京路中一大楼的房间，并将很快重新开学。
大同大学尚未找到合适的校舍。
目前只有交通大学仍留在法租界。
收到的信息显示，上海约有700所大学、中学和小学，学生人数约13万。

October 8, 1938. Morning Translation.

Standard publishes the following article :-

FRENCH AUTHORITIES AND CHINESE SCHOOLS

When certain local universities moved into
the French Concession, they were told by the French Police
that the authorities would not allow students' activities
outside classes, such as meetings, processions or the
formation of any organizations. These conditions were
accepted by the schools. However, one month after the
Chinan and Kwang Hwa Universities had started their classes
in the French Concession, they had to move out of the
Concession. The Futan and Utopia Universities also
suspended their classes on October 3. This is most
distressing.

FILE

France and China, two great republics, have
always been on friendly terms. We are grateful to France
because she is giving us sympathetic assistance in our
war of resistance. For the sake of the friendly relations
between the two countries, it is hoped that the French
Police will reconsider their ill-advised action in
oppressing Chinese schools, an action which it is feared
will have an adverse effect on the friendship between the
French and Chinese peoples.

It is also hoped that the schools
will ask the Government to conduct negotiations with the
Concession authorities and that the public will make a
strong appeal for the schools.

《标准晚报》刊登以下文章：-

法国当局与中国学校

当某些本地大学迁入法租界时，法国警察告知他们，当局不允许学生在课外进行活动，如集会、游行或组建任何组织。各学校接受了这些条件。然而，在暨南大学和光华大学在法租界开课一个月后，它们不得不搬出租界。复旦大学和大同大学也于10月3日停课。这令人非常痛心。

档案

法国和中国两个伟大的共和国一直友好相处。我们感谢法国，因为她在我们的抗战中给予了我们同情的援助。为了两国间的友好关系，希望法国警方重新考虑其压制中国学校的欠妥举动，担心此举会对中法人民之间的友谊产生不利影响。

也希望各学校请求政府与租界当局进行谈判，并希望公众为学校发出强烈呼吁。

SHANGHAI TIMES
OCT 5 1938

No Permission To Open Schools
Reason For Closing Order

Without formal permission from
French Consul-General in Shanghai
no schools can be established in the
French Concession here as all
institutions situated within the
Concession must be licenced, it was
learnt yesterday from Chinese
sources. Lack of official permission
is said to be the reason for the
closure of the Fuhtan and Utopia
Universities, recently ordered by
the French authorities here.

It was indicated by the same
sources that the order was received
more than a week ago, but the
school authorities kept it secret
thinking that negotiations with the
authorities concerned might solve
the problem of removal. Messrs. Yu
Ya-ching and Eugene Kiang, both
members of the board of directors
of the Fuhtan University, have
failed to obtain permission despite
their negotiations, it was stated.

It will be recalled that the
Fuhtan University was located in
Kiangwan prior to the hostilities,
during which it suffered heavy
damage. Several branches, of the
university were moved to the
interior, but many students prefer-
red to attend classes in Shanghai.
Soon after the conclusion of the
hostilities here the Chung Yi Build-
ing, in Peking Road was chosen as
its new and temporary site, but
this year the school authorities
decided to enlarge the institute.

Sometime ago it moved to a big
private residence on Avenue Joffre,
hoping to resume classes in the
Concession in a more spacious
school building, but this has failed.
It may move back to the Settle-
ment again in a week's time, but
as to the Utopia University the
question of finding a new site is a
difficult one.

《字林西报》
1938年10月5日

未经许可不得办学
关闭令的原因

据昨日中方消息人士透露，未经法国驻上海总领事正式许可，不得在此间法租界内设立任何学校，因为位于租界内的所有机构必须持有执照。据悉，缺乏官方许可是法国当局最近下令关闭复旦和大同大学的原因。

同一消息来源指出，该命令于一周多前收到，但校方将其保密，认为通过与有关当局谈判可能会解决搬迁问题。据说，尽管进行了谈判，复旦大学董事余雅景先生和江康黎先生均未能获得许可。

回想起来，复旦大学在战事之前位于江湾，期间遭受严重破坏。该大学的几个分部迁往内地，但许多学生更愿意在上海上课。此地战事结束后不久，北京路的中一大楼被选为其新的临时校址，但今年校方决定扩大规模。

前段时间，它迁至霞飞路的一处大型私人住宅，希望在租界内更宽敞的校舍中复课，但未成功。它可能在一周后再次搬回公共租界，但对于大同大学而言，寻找新址是一个困难的问题。

MAINICHI 4 OCT. 1938

FRENCH MUNICIPAL AUTHORITIES ORDER THREE CHINESE
UNIVERSITIES TO CLOSE

It is reported that the
French Municipal authorities have ordered the closure
of the "Chi Nan", the "Futan" and the "Dah Tung" Universities
which had removed to the French Concession from the
International Settlement after August 13 this year, on
the ground that they had not first secured permission
from the French authorities to remove into the Concession.
The real cause of the French action is due to anti-
Japanese terrorist activities as well as communist
activities of these university students for they are liable
to raise difficulties with the S.M.C. and the Japanese
authorities. Chi Nan University is reported to be
planning to remove into the International Settlement.
On October 3 the Dah Tung University was closed while
the middle school belonging to this university will close
on October 4. The University of Communications is still
functioning.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

FRENCH CONSUL-GENERAL APPROVES REOPENING OF SCHOOLS

Following the outbreak of local hostilities,
most of the schools in the International Settlement south
of the Soochow Creek have reopened. Schools situated in
the French Concession, however, were notified by the French
Consul-General to delay their reopening. At the same time
the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai City Government
also issued a circular order stating that, as the school
premises were being used as emergency hospitals and refugee
camps, they should defer their reopening for the time
being. Consequently all the schools in the French
Concession are remaining closed.
Considering that whilst carrying out a protracted
war of resistance, education should not be suspended
indefinitely, Mr. Pan Kung-chan, Commissioner of the
Bureau of Social Affairs, called on M. Grosbois, Director
of the Education Department of the French Municipal Council,
on Sept. 23 to discuss with him the early reopening of the
schools. Mr. Pan and M. Grosbois agreed perfectly on the
subject and both expressed the hope that the schools would
be able to reopen on October 1.
Mr. Pan thereupon reported the result to Mr.
O.K. Yui, the Mayor, and recommended that a formal request
be sent to the French Consul-General, which Mr. Yui did.
Yesterday a reply was received from the French
Consul-General accepting the request of Mayor Yui. Thus
the schools in the French Concession may be expected to
reopen shortly.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

法国总领事批准学校复课

继本地战事爆发后，苏州河以南公共租界内的大部分学校已经复课。然而，位于法租界的学校接到法国总领事的通知，推迟复课。同时，上海市政府社会局也发布通令，指出由于校舍被用作临时医院和难民收容所，各校应暂时推迟复课。因此，法租界内的所有学校均保持关闭状态。
考虑到在进行持久抗战的同时，教育不应无限期停办，社会局局长潘公展先生于9月23日拜访了法国公董局教育处处长格罗斯布瓦先生（M. Grosbois），与他商讨学校尽早复课事宜。潘先生与格罗斯布瓦先生在此问题上完全达成一致，双方均表示希望学校能于10月1日复课。
潘先生随即向市长俞鸿钧先生（Mr. O.K. Yui）汇报了结果，并建议向法国总领事发出正式请求，俞市长照此办理。
昨日收到法国总领事的回复，接受了俞市长的请求。因此，预计法租界内的学校不久后将复课。

September 16, 1937.    Afternoon Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

MR. PAN KUNG-CHAN ON EDUCATIONAL PROBLEM DURING WAR
TIME

Over one month has elapsed since the outbreak
of local hostilities. It is now time for schools to
re-open, but many schools cannot do so either due to their
location in the war zone or to other reasons.
Interviewed by our reporter, Mr. Pan Kung-chan,
Commissioner of the Bureau of Social Affairs, made the
following statement:- "This Bureau is considering the
local educational problem. As refugees in local school
premises are being evacuated, middle and primary schools
should arrange re-opening if possible. It is best
that universities and colleges should re-open in Shanghai,
otherwise it is suggested to request the Ministry of
Education to appropriate funds to assist these institutions
to remove to the interior. Education is essential to
the nation and it should not be suspended owing to a
defensive war."
